title: 薄膜鈮酸鋰異質整合
summary: 從晶軸、電光重疊與異質界面拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate crystal orientation, electro-optic overlap and heterogeneous interfaces, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

stages.title: 材料與模式
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「材料與模式」的模型與驗證，六項作業各自留存交付物。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units address Materials and modes through six separately saved modeling and verification work packages.

steps.title: 晶軸與偏振：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Crystal axes and polarization: model and design
steps.objective: 以「晶軸與偏振」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for crystal axes and polarization, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「晶軸與偏振」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。鈮酸鋰的電光響應是張量；晶切面、光偏振與電場方向共同決定有效係數。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「旋轉座標後重新投影電場與偏振，檢查是否誤把最大張量分量套到所有方向。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for crystal axes and polarization, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Lithium niobate has a tensor electro-optic response; cut, optical polarization and field direction determine the effective coefficient. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Rotate the coordinates and reproject field and polarization to detect misuse of the largest tensor component. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 旋轉座標後重新投影電場與偏振，檢查是否誤把最大張量分量套到所有方向。
steps.observationEn: Rotate the coordinates and reproject field and polarization to detect misuse of the largest tensor component.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：鈮酸鋰每個晶向有相同電光係數。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Lithium niobate has the same electro-optic coefficient in every direction. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交晶軸與偏振的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「旋轉座標後重新投影電場與偏振，檢查是否誤把最大張量分量套到所有方向。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for crystal axes and polarization, plus a falsifiable prediction using: Rotate the coordinates and reproject field and polarization to detect misuse of the largest tensor component.

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: Δφ≈πV/Vπ；小訊號模型還需電光重疊與行波衰減。 電極定義、偏振及波長固定；不能把教學 VπL 視為商用品規格。
knowledge.textEn: Δφ≈πV/Vπ; a small-signal model also needs electro-optic overlap and traveling-wave attenuation. Fix electrode definition, polarization and wavelength; the teaching VπL is not a commercial specification.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「薄膜鈮酸鋰異質整合」的「晶軸與偏振：模型與設計」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出晶粒、基板、接點與量測端的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「光引擎：把訊號接回來」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與批號、接合位置、熱歷史、接點讀值與顯微圖版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Crystal axes and polarization: model and design” in “Heterogeneous thin-film lithium-niobate integration”. Draw the die, substrate, joint and measurement interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Optical Engine: Restore the Signal” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for lot, joint location, thermal history, contact readings and micrograph version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 要審查「晶軸與偏振」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing crystal axes and polarization?
options: 鈮酸鋰的電光響應是張量；晶切面、光偏振與電場方向共同決定有效係數。
鈮酸鋰每個晶向有相同電光係數。
只要增加電極長度就必定提高頻寬。
optionsEn: Lithium niobate has a tensor electro-optic response; cut, optical polarization and field direction determine the effective coefficient.
Lithium niobate has the same electro-optic coefficient in every direction.
Increasing electrode length always increases bandwidth.

quiz.explanationEn: Lithium niobate has a tensor electro-optic response; cut, optical polarization and field direction determine the effective coefficient. Rotate the coordinates and reproject field and polarization to detect misuse of the largest tensor component.

steps.title: 晶軸與偏振：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Crystal axes and polarization: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 以「晶軸與偏振」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for crystal axes and polarization, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。旋轉座標後重新投影電場與偏振，檢查是否誤把最大張量分量套到所有方向。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「鈮酸鋰的電光響應是張量；晶切面、光偏振與電場方向共同決定有效係數。」與錯誤假說「只要增加電極長度就必定提高頻寬。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Rotate the coordinates and reproject field and polarization to detect misuse of the largest tensor component. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Lithium niobate has a tensor electro-optic response; cut, optical polarization and field direction determine the effective coefficient." against the incorrect hypothesis "Increasing electrode length always increases bandwidth."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 旋轉座標後重新投影電場與偏振，檢查是否誤把最大張量分量套到所有方向。
steps.observationEn: Rotate the coordinates and reproject field and polarization to detect misuse of the largest tensor component.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：只要增加電極長度就必定提高頻寬。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Increasing electrode length always increases bandwidth. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交晶軸與偏振的量測判別表：旋轉座標後重新投影電場與偏振，檢查是否誤把最大張量分量套到所有方向。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for crystal axes and polarization: Rotate the coordinates and reproject field and polarization to detect misuse of the largest tensor component. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.

steps.titleEn: Half-wave voltage-length product: model and design
steps.objective: 以「半波電壓長度積」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for half-wave voltage-length product, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「半波電壓長度積」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。在同一電極與模態定義下，VπL 用來比較相移效率；長度增加會增加光與射頻損失。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「用算例比較縮短電極後所需電壓；另列未計入的驅動阻抗與終端功率。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。 教學假設 VπL=2 V·cm，L=5 mm=0.5 cm，則 Vπ=4 V；改為 2.5 mm 得 8 V。這只比較相移效率，沒有估算終端或射頻損失。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for half-wave voltage-length product, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. At consistent electrode and mode definitions, VπL compares phase efficiency; added length also adds optical and RF loss. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Use the worked example to compare voltage after shortening electrodes; list excluded driver impedance and termination power. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances. Assume VπL=2 V·cm and L=5 mm=0.5 cm, giving Vπ=4 V; 2.5 mm gives 8 V. This compares phase efficiency without termination or RF loss.
steps.observation: 用算例比較縮短電極後所需電壓；另列未計入的驅動阻抗與終端功率。
steps.observationEn: Use the worked example to compare voltage after shortening electrodes; list excluded driver impedance and termination power.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：光相位折射率一定等於射頻有效折射率。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Optical phase index always equals RF effective index. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交半波電壓長度積的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「用算例比較縮短電極後所需電壓；另列未計入的驅動阻抗與終端功率。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for half-wave voltage-length product, plus a falsifiable prediction using: Use the worked example to compare voltage after shortening electrodes; list excluded driver impedance and termination power.

steps.objective: 以「半波電壓長度積」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for half-wave voltage-length product, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。用算例比較縮短電極後所需電壓；另列未計入的驅動阻抗與終端功率。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「在同一電極與模態定義下，VπL 用來比較相移效率；長度增加會增加光與射頻損失。」與錯誤假說「鈮酸鋰每個晶向有相同電光係數。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。 教學假設 VπL=2 V·cm，L=5 mm=0.5 cm，則 Vπ=4 V；改為 2.5 mm 得 8 V。這只比較相移效率，沒有估算終端或射頻損失。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Use the worked example to compare voltage after shortening electrodes; list excluded driver impedance and termination power. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "At consistent electrode and mode definitions, VπL compares phase efficiency; added length also adds optical and RF loss." against the incorrect hypothesis "Lithium niobate has the same electro-optic coefficient in every direction."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model. Assume VπL=2 V·cm and L=5 mm=0.5 cm, giving Vπ=4 V; 2.5 mm gives 8 V. This compares phase efficiency without termination or RF loss.
steps.observation: 用算例比較縮短電極後所需電壓；另列未計入的驅動阻抗與終端功率。
steps.observationEn: Use the worked example to compare voltage after shortening electrodes; list excluded driver impedance and termination power.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：鈮酸鋰每個晶向有相同電光係數。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Lithium niobate has the same electro-optic coefficient in every direction. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交半波電壓長度積的量測判別表：用算例比較縮短電極後所需電壓；另列未計入的驅動阻抗與終端功率。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。

Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.
